SELECT tier, is_current, count(*) versions, count(DISTINCT member_id) members, count(DISTINCT member_key) keys, min(valid_from), max(valid_from), min(valid_to), max(valid_to), max(join_date)
FROM dim_member GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT count(*) n, count(DISTINCT member_id) members, sum(CASE WHEN is_current THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) cur_rows, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_current THEN member_id END) cur_members,
 count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN valid_to='9999-12-31' THEN member_id END) open_members, sum(CASE WHEN is_current <> (valid_to='9999-12-31') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) mismatch
FROM dim_member

SELECT 'stg' src, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT member_id) m, max(valid_from) mx, sum(CASE WHEN is_current THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) cur FROM stg_member_updates
UNION ALL SELECT 'sales_max', count(*), 0, max(sale_date), 0 FROM fact_sales_line
UNION ALL SELECT 'stg_in_dim', count(*), count(DISTINCT s.member_id), max(s.valid_from), 0 FROM stg_member_updates s JOIN dim_member d USING (member_key)
UNION ALL SELECT 'gold_nonfuture', count(*), 0, max(valid_from), 0 FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND tier='Gold' AND valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-08'
SELECT tier, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS gold_members FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND tier = 'Gold' GROUP BY tier
